note: base_sql_report: three computed SQL() first arguments removed. The COMMENT that stamps the definition hash was SQL("COMMENT ON %s %s IS %s", SQL(label_for(relation_kind)), ...); it is now a literal per kind behind _relation_comment_sql(), like _drop_existing_relation() three branches and for the same reason -- the checker reads args[0] and cannot see through a lookup. The other two are the WHERE/HAVING and GROUP BY/ORDER BY clause builders, which were factored into two shared helpers taking the keyword as a string and wrapping it with SQL(keyword); the keyword now arrives already wrapped from a literal at each call site.
